handoff: New game/pathfinder.gd (RefCounted accessor exactly as the doc at the top of game/pathfinder_view.gd, plus signals arrived, build_started, build_done, build_cancelled). Flight runs on game time: main._process calls flight.sync(game_time()) only while unpaused, so pause, the event pause and speeds x1 to x12 are exact, and debug_advance_cycle moves it too. Speed is pathfinder_speed 400 data map units per cycle times ships.json speed (data units, ORBIT_SCALE divided out, so Voltara to Tillam = 1.0). Other-system flights need the permit and take pathfinder_jump_cycles/speed. Only Voltara is open at start; a post or platform opens a planet through availability rule kind 'planet' (atoms planet_visited, post_built, platform_built). Closed planets go into engine.closed_planets and events.locked, system_trade_open, can_connect and set_local_order refuse them with NOT_FLY_FIRST. Leaving a build cancels it with no refund (NOT_POST_LEAVE). Everything is off when discovery_enabled is 0 (read live). Saved under 'pathfinder'.

new_balance_keys.note: post cost = ship_price x fraction (x1.5 in system 2); platform = post cost x 2; first living post is free and builds in 1 cycle; credits are paid at build start, no refund on cancel; MIN_3 needed for a platform (const in pathfinder.gd)
